# AnalyzeG — Full Platform Documentation

## What is AnalyzeG?
AnalyzeG is a verified video review intelligence platform for consumer brands in India. Brands buy 500 to 1500 face-presence verified 30-second in-hand product videos and receive Power BI dashboards, sentiment & keyword analytics, and raw CSV/Excel with video links. Reviewers are face-presence verified consumers compensated via revenue-share.

Brand owned and operated by Souvik Dey, Udyam MSME Registered, West Bengal, India. Data Fiduciary for DPDP Act 2023 purposes. Grievance: grievance@analyzeg.co.in. Founded 2024.

## How AnalyzeG Works for Brands
1. Register your brand on AnalyzeG (app.analyzeg.co.in/b2b-auth)
2. Select review package (500 at ₹5,00,000, 1000 at ₹9,00,000, 1500 at ₹12,75,000) — one-time, GST invoice, PO accepted, DPA on request
3. Specify target demographics: state, age, gender
4. Receive 30-second in-hand product videos — face-presence verified via 5-point checks (face-presence, device, geo, content, timestamp) + human moderation, time-stamped with audit logs
5. Access Power BI dashboard with sentiment & keyword themes, competitor benchmarking, state/age/gender filters
6. Download raw CSV/Excel with video links for independent verification
7. Use own-product videos as ad creative (licensing included for main brand; competitor videos are insights-only, separate reviewer consent required)
Delivery: 2 minutes to 24 hours. SLA: 24h or 10% credit.

## How AnalyzeG Works for Reviewers
1. Sign up via For Reviewers (analyzeg.co.in/for-reviewers/) and complete profile
2. Choose categories with active brand demand (Categories Needed Now)
3. Record authentic 30-second in-hand video per checklist (face in frame, product in hand, genuine voice)
4. Submit for 5-point face-presence verification + human moderation
5. Get up to ₹40 advance after verification (in bounty categories) — then on each brand purchase, receive balance from your 50% share per sale. Example: ₹1,000 brand price → ₹500 share − ₹40 advance = ₹460 balance. 3 brand purchases = 3 payouts.
6. Payout via UPI or bank within 24h of each sale event. T&C apply.

Payment: No fee to join, no followers needed. Separate consent for ad licensing at submission.

## Pricing for Brands
- Professional: 500 reviews at ₹5,00,000 (₹1,000/review)
- Enterprise: 1,000 reviews at ₹9,00,000 (₹900/review, save ₹1,00,000)
- Market Leader: 1,500 reviews at ₹12,75,000 (₹850/review, save ₹2,25,000)
All packages: Power BI dashboard + template, raw CSV/Excel with video links, state/age/gender filters, sentiment & trend analysis, video ad licensing (own-product), one-time purchase.

## Analytics Features
- Sentiment analysis from video + survey responses
- Keyword trend detection across datasets
- Competitor benchmarking
- Demographic segmentation by state, age, gender
- Custom Power BI dashboard templates
- Raw export (CSV/Excel) with video links
- Audit logs, 180-day retention, AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3 in transit

## Technology & Verification
- 5-point face-presence verification: face-presence, device integrity, geo-consistency, content checklist, timestamp + human moderation
- NOT biometric templates unless documented; called face-presence to stay DPDP-accurate
- Securely recorded, time-stamped, audit logged

## FAQ — Brands
Q: How does verification work? A: 5-point face-presence + human moderation before sellable pool.
Q: How quickly? A: 2 minutes (pre-verified) to 24 hours (custom).
Q: Can we use videos as ads? A: Yes for own-product videos (license included); competitor videos are insights-only.
Q: Data protection? A: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.3, access controls, audit logs, DPDP 2023.

## FAQ — Reviewers
Q: How much can I earn? A: Up to ₹40 advance after verification + balance from 50% share per sale, multiple sales = multiple payouts.
Q: When paid? A: Advance after verification (bounty categories). Balance within 24h of each brand purchase.
Q: Equipment? A: Smartphone + stable internet.

## Values
- Integrity: Every review passes 5-point verification
- Innovation: Analytics turns raw video into decision-ready intelligence
- Fairness: Transparent dual-stage payout linked to quality, not rating
- Transparency: Raw data to verify every insight
